gen-gf-gugi-gf-nokora: Gugi is a bold display face whose lowercase nearly climbs to the capitals, with terminals cut open. Nokora brings a wide s and a dense, dark band of lowercase; that sturdy texture is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with an open gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase. And Gugi's steady, unshaded outline carries the bold voice while the body text stays out of its way.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Distinctive is Gugi's whole point, a display face with open-cut terminals. Noto Sans Adlam keeps curve endings well apart and its c, s and z full, and that generous, uncramped build is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, with little height gap between cases. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined would read smoothly over pages, while Gugi's bold display shapes handle the attention.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Gugi is a distinctive display face whose strokes hold the steadiness of a drawn string. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is a modern sans with outward-pointing terminals and an x-height near cap height, so it backs the heading up.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Terminals cut open let Gugi's counters flow outward, giving it a bold, distinctive display look. And Noto Sans Arabic, with its pronounced x-height and wide openings, holds up at a modest size beside it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-armenian: One stroke thickness everywhere gives Gugi its bold, distinctive display look, with terminals cut open. Noto Sans Armenian adds sans-serif lettering with full c, s and z and wide round openings, a generous counterweight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Gugi's unshaded, constant strokes make it a distinctive display face with a bold voice. But Noto Sans Avestan does the quieter work, keeping its curve tips apart and its x-height pronounced where Gugi simply announces.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Gugi leaves the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen, bold and distinctive, with open-cut terminals and lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Noto Sans Bassa Vah's dominant midsection and open-jawed c are the pair's hook.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-batak: Gugi is a distinctive display face, its pen line holding one width throughout and its terminals cut open. And Noto Sans Batak, with its towering x-height, can be set a touch smaller than you'd expect.
